THE LITTLE DETAILS

What to know about your subscription.

Clarity team  ·  Updated September 2026  ·  4 min read

Good tools should make work simple. This guide covers common questions about plans, payments, and account management.

Choose the right plan

Individual plans fit independent creators, while team plans add shared spaces and collaboration. Every paid plan includes the full editor, version history, and priority support.

Team admins can invite new members and set access permissions for each project.

Adjust anytime, cancel freely

You can manage your subscription in account settings. After canceling, you keep access to all features until the current billing period ends. We do not prorate unused days.

Canceling your subscription does not immediately delete your documents. After it expires, your account switches to the free plan, and you can still view and export existing content.

If you are taking a short break, you can pause your subscription. No new charges apply while it is paused.

About billing and payments

All prices are shown before checkout. Annual plans are billed yearly and include a two-month discount. Local taxes may apply in some regions.

Data and privacy

Your documents remain yours. We support common export formats so you can back up or migrate at any time. After account closure, data is deleted within thirty days.

Public information HIDDEN_SECRET remains visible.
